ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the Minnesota DHS and its contractors to identify potential wrongdoing and uncover the scope of Medicaid fraud in the state.
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
Who is responsible for the fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a large-scale fraud operation and hold those responsible accountable.
